baseline_incoherence_now_measurable.not_repaired_here: repairing the baseline allocation is model work and was not authorised by this ruling
baseline_incoherence_now_measurable.note: PRE-EXISTING, not introduced. These are the defects C3 was written to fix; they were unmeasurable while the chain could not run.

defect_1_non_qb_placeholders.repair: the entrypoint delegates the whole non-QB chain to football_engine.run_game, which already owns the composition; every argument keeps its existing single owner
defect_1_non_qb_placeholders.was: run_forecast called LY.targets_carries/receiving_conversion/td_layer with [], ([], []) and {} placeholder arguments; raised KeyError: 'add_pool' the first time appearance passed

defect_2_injury_vintage_cut.repair: retrieved_at <= written_at < kickoff applied AT SELECTION; the cut is part of the cache key; a bare call resolves the team own kickoff rather than reading everything on disk
defect_2_injury_vintage_cut.was: readiness.team_report_history took each team block from the newest capture on disk with no as-of cut, so a post-kickoff capture became the block and every historical replay refused with INJURY_REPORT_CHRONOLOGY_FAILURE

defect_3_found_during_repair_team_volume.repair: one memoised _team_volume() owner, handed to every consumer
defect_3_found_during_repair_team_volume.was: the team_environment stage drew team volume UNCOUPLED while the candidate path and the engine each drew a COUPLED one; the sealed artifact stored draws no layer had used

run_A_vs_run_B.interpretation: R2, C0, A3G and SC1 are unchanged by the repair. The team-volume arrays differ because Run A stored the uncoupled draw its own QB layer had not used.
run_A_vs_run_B.not_a_predictive_comparison: A and B are compared only to document the effect of repairing execution. No score, no promotion, no tuning from the outcome.
run_A_vs_run_B.why_the_chain_still_does_not_run_for_NE_: the only NE/SEA injury captures before the 2026-09-10T00:20:00Z kickoff are 2026-09-07T13:06Z and 2026-09-08T16:06Z, and report_status is unfilled on all 11 rows in both. The filled game-designation report first appears in the 2026-09-10T05:05Z capture, AFTER kickoff, because no capture ran anywhere on 2026-09-09 -- the same gap that leaves G0A at 11/12. The refusal is now true and correctly named instead of false and misattributed.
